text: The owned YAML change replaces30 .tests.tar.gz references with .tests.tar.zst while preserving their destinations and extraction settings. Metadata, ZIP and other artifact names stay distinct. Accepted later configuration retains a smaller set of these fetches; later removals and enterprise variants are separate phases. This is a consumer naming/configuration fact, not verified payload compression, upstream production or extraction compatibility. Required Bug 1994117 comment1 is missing, so available discussion stays private and this source-only row has zero full-audit credit. No build or artifact run occurred.
title: The macOS universal job changes archive names while preserving fetch roles
